essence: Therefore Śiva must be explained as having the nature of bliss-consciousness.
Therefore the glorious five-mantra-bodied deity is both with parts and without parts.
Therefore this meaning should be ascertained from the glorious Mataṅga itself.
Therefore Śiva's mantra-form power has the nature of thinking and protecting.
Therefore the use of the word mantra for denotative words is metaphorical.
